summary: Held through an initial -29/-30pt dip since against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP) were present but price had stalled rather than accelerated. Bailed at frame 4 when price nearly tripled its adverse excursion (-30 to -76pts) in one minute alongside rapidly expanding volatility (5m vol delta +6.8) and collapsing efficiency ratio (ER10 0.06) - that acceleration plus persistent against-fires signaled genuine wrong-direction, not a normal dip. Next time I'd weight the rate-of-change of the adverse excursion (not just its stall) more heavily and treat the ER10 collapse alongside vol expansion as an earlier acceleration warning.
